name: capital-program
title: Capital program
description: One shared record of every BPA F&W capital project — Hatchery, Land and Passage — with headroom against the Asset Plan, each project’s green-light pathway, a multi-year quarterly spending plan, requests, snapshots, and the year-end re-forecast.

guide.intent: The lens every capital program screen reads: Current FY, envelope source (Asset Plan Expected, Asset Plan Optimal, or IPR as information only) and snapshot (Current or any frozen snapshot), plus the data-as-of and rate-period line. Selecting a past snapshot shows a read-only banner and disables every edit on every screen.
decisions: Asset Plan Expected (SOY) is the default envelope because the agency budgets capital to the Asset Plan, not the IPR (Oct 5 meeting).
The lens lives in the store, not the URL, so it carries across the six screens.
Snapshots are read-only views of frozen data, never editable copies.
acceptance: Changing Current FY shifts every FY column and the headroom panel.
Choosing a snapshot shows "Viewing snapshot … (as of …)" and hides edit actions; "Back to current" restores them.

guide.intent: Answers "can we say yes?" for the selected FY: one tile per category plus total, each showing envelope, Active forecast, Placeholder forecast, open requests and headroom = envelope − (Active + Placeholder), with the Optimal ceiling and room to it. The Passage tile shows the placeholder being drawn down by named projects and the competing asks. A "What if we say yes?" checklist counts chosen requests against headroom; a "freed this year" line lists current-FY reductions since the last snapshot.
decisions: Open requests are shown beside headroom, never subtracted from it unless ticked in what-if.
Optimal = Expected ÷ 0.8 unless an Optimal figure is entered ("Finance can approve up to Optimal").
Requests with category TBD count in the total tile only.
Clicking a tile filters the grid below to that category (event cbf-cap:filter-category).
gotchas: Headroom can be negative; show it in parentheses and red with "Short by n".
FY29+ has no envelope in the seed — tiles read "No envelope", not zero.
acceptance: FY27 vs Asset Plan Expected: headroom 0 against 48,415; 12,104 room to the 60,519 Optimal ceiling; open requests 30,900.
FY27 vs IPR: 18,573, tagged information only.
Ticking every FY27 request: total headroom (30,900).

guide.intent: The capital budget spreadsheet with more columns: every project grouped Hatchery Expand, Hatchery Sustain, Land, Passage with a subtotal per group and a pinned grand total. Columns follow the Current FY (prior FY actuals, current FY forecast and YTD actuals, FY+1 to FY+3), plus record type, stage, OMB and NPCC status, design status, modified budget, remaining and last note; account type, in current Asset Plan and a pathway-dot strip are optional columns.
decisions: No esa data-grid lego exists, so the table is AG Grid Community on the shared token theme; filters are esa-chip-group, esa-select and esa-switch-toggle; the column picker is esa-popover + esa-checkbox-group.
Sorting happens within groups: postSortRows keeps each group header, its rows and its subtotal together.
Placeholders read muted with a dashed left edge, and one switch drops them from the totals.
A red "OMB not approved" pill marks construction-contract spend in an open quarter without appropriations language (R7); "Flagged only" lists them.
Filters live in sessionStorage so the browser back button from Project detail returns to the same view.
gotchas: Row ids are stable across rebuilds, so the grid forces a cell refresh after each rebuild or group counts go stale.
Negative values display in parentheses, matching the source reports.
acceptance: FY27 grand total 48,415 (16,183 / 21,495 / 10,737 by category); FY28 total 63,846.
Flagged only shows Chief Joseph Hatchery water temperature and Sherman Creek Intake.
